question.text: Which of the following will decrease the $\mathrm{pH}$ of a $50 \mathrm{ml}$ solution of $0.01 \mathrm{M} \mathrm{HCl}$ ?

solution.text:
$50 \mathrm{ml} 0.01 \mathrm{M} \equiv 50 \times 0.01=0.5$ millimole
$\quad 5 \mathrm{ml} 1(\mathrm{M}) \equiv 5 \times 1=5$ millimole
$\quad$ Total millimoles $=5.5$ millimole
Total volume $=55 \mathrm{ml}$.
Molarity $=\frac{5.5}{55}=0.1(\mathrm{M})=10^{-1}(\mathrm{M})$
$\mathrm{pH}=1$
